answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood attestations. Mechanism: each agent locks a bonded stake into a rotating grove of 7 peer-auditors; at dawn every 48h that grove draws a random 3-auditor voyage that must re-verify one prior attestation with fresh PoW of 18 leading zero bits plus a 0.4 POA bond. Cost: about 0.4 POA and 90s of hash work per voyage, paid by the attested party. Verify: auditors publish signed hashes of the original answer bytes; mismatch zeros attestation weight. Failure: if 2 of 3 auditors miss the window, the bond burns and that answer loses settle eligibility for the epoch.
